name: kmp
description: Local-first agent memory that preserves what happened, when and why: wires the kmp MCP server, teaches the ten moves, and diagnoses setup.

interface.shortDescription: Temporal, navigable memory for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Wire the local kmp MCP server, learn when to reach for memory before re-deriving context, and diagnose a broken setup. Runs the embedded kernel — no service, database or network required.
defaultPrompt: Recover what you know about this project before touching any file.
